tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// sho dgon gyi dge 'dun rnams la spring pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter yon tan pad+mo'i tshal// phan bde'i dri bzangs dge 'dun bung bas bsten// ting 'dzin sbrang rtsis skye dgu'i gdungs sel ba// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /dam pa dam pa'i skye bo 'du ba'i gnas// bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan 'dzin pa// dben gnas dben la dga' ba 'du ba'i gzhi// dgon pa'i dam pa sho dgon zhes su grags// der gnas dge 'dun rnams la don 'di spring*// sdom brtson dam pa ting 'dzin mchog brnyes pa// yang dag lam ston 'gro la bu bzhin brtse// bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin bla ma dam pa de// zhi bar gshegs zhes bdag gi ring nas khums// de la gshegs dang bzhugs pa yongs mi mnga'// gshegs dang bzhugs pa 'jig rten blun pos btags// dam pa'i don du chos rnams nye bar zhi// brtson ldan khyed kyis don 'di legs mkhyen mod// 'on kyang snyigs dus bsod nams zhan pa dang*// rtsod pa'i dus kyis 'gro ba blun pas na// dam pa'i don la dpyod pa zhan pa'i phyir// 'das pa yin zhes gdung ba mi bzad skye// 'khrul pa'i snang dor bde gshegs bstan pa yang*// ston ka'i char bzhin kun nas 'bri ba mthong*// skye bo dam pa'i 'bras bu phal cher yang*// dus kyi shugs kyis rnam par ltung bar snang*// de yi slad du dge 'dun rnams// dngos po'i chos nyid mkhyen pas na// rnam pa kun du thugs gtod ces// ring nas gnas pa bdag gsol 'debs// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas// shar phyogs kyi sa'i cha gnam 'phang mtho zhing rgyar yangs la yid du 'ong ba/ ri bo chen po rin po che 'bar ba lta bu'i ngogs/ rtsi shing dang nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ mdzes pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang*/ sgra snyan pa'i bya du mas gang ba/

grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ dpal gyi sho dgon na bzhugs pa'i rin chen gdan sa pas dbu mdzad dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu spring ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la gcig tu gzhol ba/ 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i ngang tshul can bla ma dam pa de la 'das grongs mi mnga' yang*/ skye bo rtag 'dzin can rnams drang ba'i phyir/ bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dmas shing*/ sems can rnams mgon dang bral ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang yang dag pa'i don la dgongs la thugs khral mi mdzad par zhu// //rdzas dang bkur sti la sogs pa'ang*// mchod pa'i khyad par yin mod kyi// yang dag bla ma dam pa la// bsgrub pa'i mchod pa de bas lhag /de slad tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang*// rnam grol ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir// sdom brtson dge 'dun khyed rnams kyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// bla ma dam pa mnyes bya'i phyir// yang dag brtul zhugs brtan pa yis// rnam pa kun du brtson mdzad na// bla ma thub pa mnyes par 'gyur// spring yig tsha zer byed ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa'i tshogs bsal te// dge 'dun pad+mo'i tshogs rnams rgyas byed cing*// bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gsal gyur cig /byang chub snying po dam par byang chub pa// mnyam med de ni chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed// log ltung mgon med phongs pa'i skyabs gyur pa// kun mkhyen 'gro mgon de yi zhabs la 'dud// yon tan dpag med chab kyis legs gang zhing*// lung rigs man ngag rin chen gter gyis phyug /yid bzhin mtsho 'dra dpal ldan sa skya nas// mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*// blang dor legs par phyed pa'i shes rab ldan// tshul khrims legs bsrungs lta ba dag pa can// sde snod 'dzin pa de yi spring yig 'di// byams pa'i thugs dgongs phan bde'i 'phrin las can// shar phyogs smar khams zhing na legs bzhugs pa// sde dgon yon mchod rnams kyi phyag tu phul//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
